If a player can't pay the cost to untap, but has a HG he can get blood
from, can he get a blood first and then pay the cost with it? IIRC
untapping minions goes before anythin else in the untap phase..am I
right?

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
cantila <rogc...@student.luth.se> wrote:
> If a player can't pay the cost to untap, but has a HG he can get blood
> from, can he get a blood first and then pay the cost with it? IIRC
> untapping minions goes before anythin else in the untap phase..am I
> right?

In general, there is no cost to untap, so the question doesn't
come up.

If you have an effect (like Derange, Detection, Kindred Society
Games, Restructure, etc.) that says that the vampire doesn't
untap as normal and also give the vampire the ability to pay a
blood to untap during his own untap phase, then he can benefit
from the hunting ground and then pay to untap.

The "untap as normal" is the first thing that happens during an
untap phase - everything else can be ordered.

Some cards, like Whispers of the Nictuku, make the "untap as
normal" cost additional blood, however. These effects cannot
be paid with hunting ground blood, since they increase the
cost of "untapping as normal", which happens first.
